summary: MSP Recovery, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a letter agreement with Hazel Partners Holdings LLC for a one-time $0.1 million advance under its existing working capital credit facility. The filing details a discretionary increase to the Operational Collection Floor for operating expenses, with no committed liquidity, borrowing base, or obligation to fund. This is a routine credit facility arrangement, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, management change, or other event-driven corporate action.
